projects.name: FDOT Adopted Work Program 2027-2031 (WorkProgram_2027-2031_AD_G1)
projects.notes: FDOT five-year Adopted Work Program, fiscal years 2027-2031, hosted in FDOT's ArcGIS Online organization. One record per project segment and phase: PHASE (code) / PHASE_NAME / DESCRIPT (phase description), FISCAL_YEAR (2027-2031) and AMOUNT are for that phase, so a project appears several times and its cost is the sum. PHASE = ROW (right of way) is the direct land-acquisition signal; PE / PDE / ENV = in development; CST / DSB = construction funded in that fiscal year. No letting date, only fiscal year. WPITEM + WPITMSEG form the financial project number. Also DISTRICT, CATEGORY (HIGHWAYS / TURNPIKE / MAINTENANCE / MISCELLANEOUS), BEGIN_MILE, END_MILE. The same organization has WorkProgram_UnMapped_2027_2031_AD_G1 (items without geometry). The layer name is tied to the program years, so the URL will change with each annual work program. FDOT's own server gis.fdot.gov answered HTTP 406 to a plain automated request and was not used.

parcels_statewide.name: Florida Statewide Cadastral (CADASTRAL_DOR)
parcels_statewide.notes: Statewide parcels joined to the Department of Revenue tax roll (NAL fields), all 67 counties. JV = just (market) value; LND_VAL = land value. There is no acres field: LND_SQFOOT is land area in square feet (divide by 43,560). CO_NO is the DOR county number (11 = Alachua in the sample), not FIPS and not a name. ASMNT_YR was 2026 in the sample. DOR_UC = land use code; sale fields SALE_PRC1 / SALE_YR1. maxRecordCount 2000. No use restriction is stated on the service. A centroid version exists in the same organization: Florida_Statewide_Parcel_Centroid_Version. SPATIAL QUERIES (checked 2026-11-17): the layer is stored in a custom Florida state-plane spatial reference (wkid 102967 / 6439) and a distance buffer fails unless an output spatial reference is given. Add outSR=4326 to every point+distance request. Working example: https://services9.arcgis.com/Gh9awoU677aKree0/arcgis/rest/services/Florida_Statewide_Cadastral/FeatureServer/0/query?geometry=-81.3790,28.5385&geometryType=esriGeometryPoint&inSR=4326&spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects&distance=200&units=esriSRUnit_Meter&outSR=4326&outFields=*&returnGeometry=false&f=json . Envelope and polyline intersects queries work without it. Do not combine resultRecordCount with a spatial filter (error 400). Terms: the ArcGIS Online item (owner FloridaGIO, id efa909d6b1c841d298b0a649e7f71cf2) licence text was read; it is an accuracy disclaimer only and states no limit on commercial use or solicitation.

spatial_query.working_form: point + distance WITH outSR=4326 (or outSR=3857) added; GET
spatial_query.fails: the same request without outSR returns error 400 'Cannot perform query. Invalid query parameters.' / '24204: The spatial reference identifier (SRID) is not valid' (HTTP status 200, error in the JSON body), also for returnCountOnly and for units in feet
also_works: envelope without distance: geometry=-81.381,28.537,-81.377,28.540&geometryType=esriGeometryEnvelope&inSR=4326 (39 parcels, no outSR needed)
polyline JSON geometry with spatialReference wkid 4326, no distance (count 9)
also_fails: resultRecordCount=1 together with a spatial filter returned error 400 in every form tried (with where, with orderByFields): page spatial results by maxRecordCount 2000 / exceededTransferLimit instead
a point with no distance only matches when it falls inside a parcel (returns 0 features on a street)

summary: Both needs are met statewide: FDOT's adopted five-year work program with a right-of-way phase, and statewide parcels with owner name and mailing address. The work program layer is per phase and its URL changes each program year.
